response.body: Adopt ADS in new/existing projects using a pinned Git submodule by default; retain migration path from older copy/remote-pin layouts, private repo access handling and clean working-tree guards. Add an AI-native how-to-update guide explaining `git submodule update --init` only checks out recorded gitlink, not newer ADS. Discovery on task-start lightweight, end of phase, manual trigger; optional weekly read-only check via host scheduling if explicitly configured. Compare current gitlink SHA to trusted release/approved tag/commit, classify breaking changes, run project-local adaptation/Skill discovery/CI, update gitlink with PR; no unattended `--remote` to mutable main or unexpected auto-deploy. Track relevant versions across v0.2/v0.3. Never invent a new CLI/service. Demonstrate isolated old-pin-to-new-pin update with rollback and inaccessible private repo handling.
